figures.title: Adding velocities never exceeds c
figures.why: Galilean addition overshoots c; the denominator is the whole chapter
figures.read: at high speed the denominator bends every sum back under c

figures.title: The gamma factor: slow to rise, then vertical
figures.why: every exam speed must be converted to gamma first
figures.read: the last percent of light speed multiplies the factor sixfold
